description: Any Class may learn these Talents. The animal uses its own NPC Unit profile, not the owner's PC weapon/spell profiles, and is an independent friendly Unit. A companion may use a Command only when its profile or an acquired upgrade expressly grants it one; such Commands use the controlling player's CP and follow normal personal-Unit activation timing.

talents.name: Animal Companion
effect: Gain one bonded Small or Standard Animal Companion from the Bestiary (17_bestiary.md#7-animal-companions), as printed, without free Training upgrades. Add that companion's listed Points to the PC's battlefield value. It:
Activates independently during Movement, Assault, and eligible Combat Phases, following the chosen combat mode's normal Unit order.
Makes its own Move, one Assault action, Charge, and Engagement Attack when eligible; it does not attack alongside its owner's activation for free.
Maintains its own Wounds, Saves, Keywords and equipment/Attack profiles.
Remains within Short Range of its owner whenever reasonably possible.
Cannot control objectives independently, contribute Command Points, or use Commands that it has not explicitly learned.
Does not receive the owner's personal Prowess, equipment improvements, or Talents unless a rule states otherwise.
If Defeated, it is unavailable for the remainder of that encounter; recovery or replacement is settled between adventures. Only one bonded companion is gained through this Tier 2 Talent.

talents.name: Greater Animal Companion
talents.effect: Choose one of the following options when acquiring this Talent.

options.name: Develop one companion
options.effect: Keep the existing companion and give it two different Companion Training upgrades from the Companion Training table.

options.name: Bond a second companion
options.effect: Gain a second Small or Standard Animal Companion as printed; give one Companion Training upgrade to each of the two companions.

notes: Both companions remain separate friendly Units with independent activations, and both have their listed Bestiary Points added to the PC's battlefield value.
Training benefits are part of this 20-XP Talent and do not add an extra Point surcharge.
A PC may have at most two bonded companions from these Talents.

A specific Training benefit may be selected only once per companion. Separate Bestiary upgrades purchased for Points remain subject to their own limits; identical benefits may not be taken twice merely by changing their source.
Training does not allow an animal to use a Command it does not normally possess. Creature-specific CP Commands, such as a bird's Spot Prey, may be bought when allowed by its Bestiary entry.

companionTraining.name: Ferocious
companionTraining.effect: +1 Attack die on one chosen Engagement Attack profile

companionTraining.name: Precise
companionTraining.effect: One chosen Attack profile gains Accurate 1

companionTraining.name: Protective
companionTraining.effect: Gain Cover 1 against eligible ranged Attacks
